Hourly wage to annual salary

Hourly rate × hours per week × paid weeks

Use your regular schedule and subtract any unpaid weeks.

$25 × 40 × 52 = $52,000

Annual salary to hourly wage

Annual salary ÷ annual scheduled hours

A 40-hour week over 52 weeks adds up to 2,080 hours.

$60,000 ÷ 2,080 = $28.85/hr

Common questions

Are these calculators really free?

Yes. Every calculator on this page is free to use as often as you like, with no account, no email address and no download. The tools are supported by the site itself, not by selling data.

Do the calculators store or send my numbers?

No. Each calculation runs entirely in your browser using the numbers you type in. Nothing is uploaded, saved or shared, and closing the page clears everything.

Are the results before or after tax?

Before tax. The calculators work with gross pay — the amount before income tax, Social Security and Medicare, and benefit deductions. Enter your own deduction amounts in the paycheck calculator if you want a closer estimate.
